verdict.rationale: Marlin runs autonomously for up to ~8 hours after a brief setup exchange, executing research end-to-end (hypothesis forming, web navigation, contradiction resolution, report/slide generation) without further human input, matching the 'background automation' story well.  However, this is a single research-task automation rather than a general-purpose 'set up automations' scheduler/trigger system, and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs. Missing for 10: evidence of recurring/scheduled automations (not just one-off runs), independent verification of the 8-hour autonomous claim, and details on triggering/monitoring multiple background jobs.
